name: @reverse-craft/rc-devtools-mcp

tools.name: clear_all_breakpoints
tools.description: Remove all active JavaScript breakpoints on the current page.

tools.name: clear_vmasm_breakpoints
tools.description: Remove all vmasm breakpoints for the current session.

tools.name: click
tools.description: Clicks on the provided element

uid.description: The uid of an element on the page from the page content snapshot

dblClick.description: Set to true for double clicks. Default is false.

tools.name: disable_debugger
tools.description: Disable the JavaScript debugger on the current page and remove all breakpoints.

tools.name: evaluate_on_call_frame
tools.description: Evaluate a JavaScript expression in the context of a specific call frame when paused.

tools.name: evaluate_script
tools.description: Evaluate JavaScript code inside the currently selected page, similar to DevTools Console.

script.description: JavaScript code to execute in the page context.

maxOutputChars.description: Maximum number of characters in the output. Default is 10000.

tools.name: fill
tools.description: Type text into a input, text area or select an option from a <select> element.

uid.description: The uid of an element on the page from the page content snapshot

tools.name: get_console_message
tools.description: Gets a console message by its ID. You can get all messages by calling list_console_messages.

msgid.description: The msgid of a console message on the page from the listed console messages

tools.name: get_debugger_status
tools.description: Get the current status of the JavaScript debugger including call stack, code context, and scope variables.

tools.name: get_network_request
tools.description: Get a network request by reqid, or the currently selected request in DevTools if omitted.

reqid.description: The reqid of the network request. If omitted returns the currently selected request in the DevTools Network panel.

tools.name: get_possible_breakpoints
tools.description: Discover all valid breakpoint locations in a script at a specific line. Useful for minified code.

tools.name: get_scope_variables
tools.description: Get detailed variable information from a specific scope when paused at a breakpoint.

tools.name: get_vm_state
tools.description:
Get the current virtual machine state when paused at a breakpoint.

Returns comprehensive debugging information including:
- JSVMP Registers (ip, sp, stack, bytecode, storage)
- JSVMP Transform variables (semantic meaning of current opcode with AST-transformed expressions)
- Opcode Listing (surrounding instructions with resolved constant values)
- JSVMP Call Stack (virtual call frames)
- Scope Chain (local, closure, global variables)

Uses register mappings from the loaded vmasm file to locate the correct variables.

**Note:** Must be paused at a breakpoint to use this tool.

contextLines.description: Number of bytecode instructions to show before/after current (default: 5)

tools.name: list_breakpoints
tools.description: List all active JavaScript breakpoints on the current page.

searchTerm.description: Search term to filter breakpoints by ID or URL pattern.

pageSize.description: Maximum number of breakpoints to return per page.

tools.name: list_console_messages
tools.description: List all console messages for the currently selected page since the last navigation.

pageSize.description: Maximum number of messages to return. When omitted, returns all requests.

pageIdx.description: Page number to return (0-based). When omitted, returns the first page.

types.description: Filter messages to only return messages of the specified resource types. When omitted or empty, returns all messages.

includePreservedMessages.description: Set to true to return the preserved messages over the last 3 navigations.

savePath.description: File path to save console messages. When provided, messages are saved to this file.

maxLineLength.description: Maximum length of each console message line. Messages exceeding this length will be truncated. Default is 500.

tools.name: list_network_requests
tools.description: List all requests for the currently selected page since the last navigation. Supports optional keyword filtering.

keyword.description: Filter requests by keyword in URL, request/response headers, or request/response bodies. When omitted or empty, returns all requests.

pageSize.description: Maximum number of requests to return. When omitted, returns all requests.

pageIdx.description: Page number to return (0-based). When omitted, returns the first page.

resourceTypes.description: Filter requests to only return requests of the specified resource types. When omitted or empty, returns all requests.

includePreservedRequests.description: Set to true to return the preserved requests over the last 3 navigations.

tools.name: list_pages
tools.description: Get a list of pages open in the browser.

tools.name: list_vmasm_breakpoints
tools.description:
List all active vmasm breakpoints for the current session.

Shows breakpoint ID, address, opcode, and any conditions.

tools.name: list_xhr_breakpoints
tools.description: List all active XHR/Fetch breakpoints.

tools.name: load_vmasm
tools.description:
Load a vmasm file, generate debug script, and configure script interception automatically.

This tool:
1. Parses the vmasm file and extracts metadata
2. Generates a debug version of the source JS file with breakpoint instrumentation
3. Configures Fetch interception to serve the debug file when the original script is requested

After loading, you can:
- Set breakpoints using set_vmasm_breakpoint
- Get VM state when paused using get_vm_state
- List breakpoints using list_vmasm_breakpoints

**IMPORTANT:** Refresh the page after loading for the debug script to take effect.

filePath.description: Path to the vmasm file (absolute or relative to current working directory)

sourceFilePath.description: Path to the original JS source file (if not specified in vmasm @source directive)

tools.name: navigate_page
tools.description: Navigates the currently selected page to a URL.

type.description: Navigate the page by URL, back or forward in history, or reload.

ignoreCache.description: Whether to ignore cache on reload.

enableDebugger.description: Whether to enable the JavaScript debugger after navigation. Default is true.

timeout.description: Maximum wait time in milliseconds. If set to 0, the default timeout will be used.

tools.name: new_page
tools.description: Creates a new page

url.description: URL to load in a new page.

incognito.description: Whether to open the page in a new incognito window.

newWindow.description: Whether to open the page in a new window.

userDataDir.description: Optional independent resource directory (user data directory). If provided, a new browser instance with its own window will be started.

enableDebugger.description: Whether to enable the JavaScript debugger for the new page. Default is true.

timeout.description: Maximum wait time in milliseconds. If set to 0, the default timeout will be used.

tools.name: press_key
tools.description: Press a key or key combination for keyboard shortcuts and navigation keys.

key.description: A key or a combination (e.g., "Enter", "Control+A", "Control++", "Control+Shift+R"). Modifiers: Control, Shift, Alt, Meta

tools.name: remove_breakpoint
tools.description: Remove a previously set JavaScript breakpoint by its CDP breakpoint ID.

breakpointId.description: The CDP breakpoint ID to remove (returned by set_breakpoint or list_breakpoints).

tools.name: remove_vmasm_breakpoint
tools.description:
Remove a vmasm breakpoint by its ID.

Use `list_vmasm_breakpoints` to see active breakpoints and their IDs.

tools.name: remove_xhr_breakpoint
tools.description: Remove a previously set XHR/Fetch breakpoint by its URL pattern, or remove all XHR breakpoints.

tools.name: resume_execution
tools.description: Resume JavaScript execution after hitting a breakpoint.

tools.name: save_network_request
tools.description: Save a network request and response to a local file in raw HTTP format.

reqid.description: The reqid of the network request. If omitted, uses the currently selected request in the DevTools Network panel.

filePath.description: Absolute or relative file path where the HTTP transaction will be saved.

responseBodyFilePath.description: Optional file path to save the response body when it is binary. When omitted, it will be derived from filePath.

saveRequestBody.description: When true, also saves the request body to a separate file. Useful for binary or encoded request bodies.

requestBodyFilePath.description: Optional file path to save the request body. When omitted but saveRequestBody is true, it will be derived from filePath.

tools.name: save_scope_variables
tools.description: Save all scope variables from the current debug context to a JSON file.

tools.name: save_static_resource
tools.description: Save a static resource from a network request to a local file. File extension is automatically determined.

reqid.description: The reqid of the network request containing the resource to save.

filePath.description: Path to save the file. Can be a full file path (e.g., "/path/to/file.js") or a directory path (e.g., "/path/to/dir/"). If a directory, filename is derived from the URL.

tools.name: select_page
tools.description: Select a page as a context for future tool calls.

pageIdx.description: The index of the page to select. Call list_pages to get available pages.

bringToFront.description: Whether to focus the page and bring it to the top.

tools.name: set_breakpoint
tools.description: Set a JavaScript breakpoint at a specific line in a file matching a URL pattern. Supports smart snapping for minified code. Returns the CDP breakpoint ID which can be used to remove the breakpoint later.

urlRegex.description: Regular expression to match the URL of the script file. Use ".*filename\.js.*" pattern.

lineNumber.description: The line number to set the breakpoint at (1-based, as shown in editors).

columnNumber.description: Optional target column number (0-based) for smart snapping.

snapRange.description: Search range around the target column for finding valid breakpoint positions. Defaults to 100.

condition.description: Optional JavaScript expression. The breakpoint only triggers when this evaluates to true.

tools.name: set_vmasm_breakpoint
tools.description:
Set a breakpoint at a vmasm bytecode address.

The breakpoint will trigger when the virtual machine's instruction pointer (Virtual_IP) reaches the specified address.

**Note:** Requires a vmasm file to be loaded first using `load_vmasm`.

The address must be a valid bytecode address from the loaded vmasm file.
Supports both hex string format (e.g., "0x0000", "0x100") and decimal (e.g., 0, 256).

address.description: Bytecode address - supports hex string (e.g., "0x0000", "0x100") or decimal number (e.g., 0, 256)

tools.name: set_xhr_breakpoint
tools.description: Set an XHR/Fetch breakpoint that pauses execution when a request URL contains the specified substring.

tools.name: step_into
tools.description: Step into a function call at the current line.

tools.name: step_out
tools.description: Step out of the current function to return to the caller.

tools.name: step_over
tools.description: Step over to the next line of code without stepping into function calls.

tools.name: take_screenshot
tools.description: Take a screenshot of the page or element.

format.description: Type of format to save the screenshot as. Default is "png"

quality.description: Compression quality for JPEG and WebP formats (0-100). Higher values mean better quality but larger file sizes. Ignored for PNG format.

uid.description: The uid of an element on the page from the page content snapshot. If omitted takes a pages screenshot.

fullPage.description: If set to true takes a screenshot of the full page instead of the currently visible viewport. Incompatible with uid.

filePath.description: The absolute path, or a path relative to the current working directory, to save the screenshot to instead of attaching it to the response.

tools.name: take_snapshot
tools.description: Take a text snapshot of the currently selected page based on the a11y tree. Lists page elements with unique identifiers. Supports search filtering and pagination.

verbose.description: Whether to include all possible information available in the full a11y tree. Default is false.

filePath.description: The absolute path, or a path relative to the current working directory, to save the snapshot to instead of attaching it to the response. Useful for saving large snapshots that can be searched with grep/rg tools.

search.description: Filter snapshot to only include elements matching this text (case-insensitive). Matches against element name, role, and other attributes.

pageSize.description: Number of elements per page for pagination. If not specified, all matching elements are returned.

pageIdx.description: Page index (0-based) for pagination. Requires pageSize to be set.

stderr:
rc-devtools-mcp exposes content of the browser instance to the MCP clients allowing them to inspect,
debug, and modify any data in the browser or DevTools.
Avoid sharing sensitive or personal information that you do not want to share with MCP clients.
